name: Stuck: a button is greyed out
covers: Getting stuck. Unattended, the run stops here with a screenshot and a UI Automation dump. Watched, you can put the app right yourself and try again.

steps.say: Watching? This case gets stuck on purpose. When it does, tick "I have checked the orders" in Order Desk yourself, then choose Try again, and it carries on.
Click Export orders, without ticking "I have checked the orders" first
